name: fetch-esql-q5-title-length-ranking
query: FROM wikipedia METADATA _score, _id | WHERE MATCH(content, "California") | EVAL adjusted_score = _score + LENGTH(title) * 0.01 | SORT adjusted_score DESC | LIMIT 10

name: fetch-esql-q6-rrf-100
query: FROM wikipedia METADATA _score, _id, _index | FORK (WHERE MATCH(title, "artificial intelligence") | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 100) (WHERE MATCH(content, "artificial intelligence") | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 100) | FUSE | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10
